title: Malicious code in @c1-ease/recovery (npm)
description: The npm package '@c1-ease/recovery' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. Installation of this package can lead to full system compromise, including unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected machine. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but due to potential full control by an attacker, removal alone may not eliminate all malicious components.
